title: Melissa officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Melissa officinalis tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the lemon balm plant, which is known for its calming and soothing properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to alleviate anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The tea is often consumed as a mild sedative to help ease stress and nervous tension. Its mild flavor makes it a popular choice for those seeking natural remedies for emotional and mental well-being. In traditional medicine, it has also been used to support digestion and reduce inflammation.
